messages:
clara: FYI, a handful of scheduled workers failed auth this morning. They use org-level svc keys but try to touch project-scoped configs.
rahul: saw logs. new RBAC rejects if token missing project claim. many jobs were issued years ago with service keys.
lucy: proposal: short-term fallback where AuthN can assert a project claim from an explicit mapping table but only when org opts in and request originates from verified internal queue. add strong audit.
clara: agree. we must not auto-synthesize claims without opt-in. add a header like X-Auth-Decision: asserted-mapping for visibility.
ops-bot: checklist:
- DB migration: service_project_mappings
- Admin API to manage mappings
- Feature flag per-org: auth.assert_mapped_projects
- Audit entries: actor, svc_id, mapped_project_id
rahul: long-term: move workers to workload-identity minted short-lived project tokens. migration timeline ~2-3 months. dual-accept for 4-6 weeks.
lucy: i'll draft the mapping schema and admin UX. clara: i'll own migration RFC and rollout plan. rahul: i'll implement auth changes + trace header.
clara: ok proceed with caution and testing. add CI test for mapping revocation.
